title: Concurrency testing
proves: Under parallel requests, jobs and processes, caps/limits hold, duplicates are rejected, state changes do not lose updates, and a Redis outage or stalled job is survived (14 suites, each on its own Postgres and Redis testcontainers, random seeds printed).
doesNotProve: Separate machines or a database failover (multi-node tests are processes on one computer); exactly-once for kill tests; five runs per suite is evidence of stability, not proof.
